required_vc4kernel_contract: kernel ABI remains downstream VC4Kernel work
features.diagnostic_policy: diagnose missing/invalid kernel metadata
features.verification: verifier checks function attrs and grid-rank shape
features.summary: func.func with vc4value.kernel and vc4value.grid_rank metadata is the value-kernel wrapper contract.
features.notes: Admissibility only; no ABI lowering.

required_vc4kernel_contract: VC4Kernel program_id/num_programs are later lowering targets
features.diagnostic_policy: diagnose non-kernel use or axis outside containing grid rank
features.verification: verifier walks vc4value ops and checks containing func metadata
features.summary: only vc4value.program_id and vc4value.num_programs are allowed launch identity ops.
features.notes: Logical launch identity, not physical QPU identity.

required_vc4kernel_contract: producer dialects must lower before VC4Kernel
features.diagnostic_policy: diagnose any operation from outside the allowed family
features.verification: audit and verifier check operation dialect namespaces
features.summary: builtin, func, vc4value, vector, memref, arith, math, scf, and cf are the only value-surface dialect family.
features.notes: Allowed syntax does not imply lowering.

required_vc4kernel_contract: raw pointer ABI is Phase4/5+ work
features.diagnostic_policy: diagnose unranked memref or rank greater than 2
features.summary: ranked rank-1/rank-2 logical memref types with supported scalar element types are admissible value-surface memory types.
features.notes: No memory-space attr is finalized in Phase3.

required_vc4kernel_contract: VC4Kernel may use vector<16xT> carriers later
features.diagnostic_policy: diagnose scalable vectors or vector rank greater than 2
features.summary: fixed non-scalable rank-1/rank-2 vector types with supported scalar element types are admissible value-surface vector types.
features.notes: No VC4Kernel fragment lowering in Phase3.

required_vc4kernel_contract: lane identity remains planner/lowering work
features.diagnostic_policy: diagnose forbidden dialect alternatives such as vc4value.lane_id
features.verification: operation whitelist admits standard lane/mask syntax
features.summary: vector.step, splat/broadcast, constants, and mask constructors are admissible value-surface syntax.
features.notes: Lane representation is vector.step.

required_vc4kernel_contract: TMU/VDR/VDW/VPM choice is later planning
features.diagnostic_policy: diagnose direct memref side-effect bypasses
features.verification: operation policy accepts transfers and rejects direct side effects
features.summary: vector.transfer_read/write are admissible standard memory semantics, but lowering is not implemented in Phase 3.
features.notes: Accepting syntax does not claim hardware path support.

required_vc4kernel_contract: SFU approximate policy remains explicit later
features.diagnostic_policy: diagnose forbidden target math forms only if outside allowed dialects
features.summary: arith/math dialect syntax belongs to the value surface, with exact/finite/approx policy enforced by later lowering phases.
features.notes: Exact/default math must not silently lower to SFU.

required_vc4kernel_contract: VC4Kernel verified output is a later boundary
features.diagnostic_policy: diagnose lower-half dialect control in value input
features.summary: restricted scf/cf value control syntax is admissible, but scf must not survive into verified vc4kernel later.
features.notes: Phase3 does not canonicalize control flow.

required_vc4kernel_contract: N/A
features.diagnostic_policy: diagnose matrix/schema drift
features.verification: matrix checker and audit scripts validate contract
features.summary: value-surface matrix and audits are internal contract machinery.
features.notes: Internal guardrail only.

required_vc4kernel_contract: VC4Kernel remains downstream
features.diagnostic_policy: diagnose conversion/lowering claims in Phase3 audits
features.summary: Phase 3 must not claim or perform value-to-vc4kernel lowering.
features.notes: Lowering starts Phase5 after ABI lock.

required_vc4kernel_contract: TTIR must enter after handwritten value path is proven
features.diagnostic_policy: diagnose TTIR/Triton import claims
features.verification: audit scans tools and docs for readiness contradictions
features.summary: Phase 3 must not claim or perform TTIR/Triton ingestion.
features.notes: READY_FOR_TRITON remains NO.

required_vc4kernel_contract: producer dialects are not VC4Kernel
features.diagnostic_policy: diagnose forbidden producer dialect namespace
features.summary: tt, ttg, gpu, linalg, nvgpu, nvvm, rocdl, spirv, iree, stablehlo, and mhlo are rejected in value-surface inputs.
features.notes: Future inputs must canonicalize first.

required_vc4kernel_contract: target/lower-half dialects are below the value surface
features.diagnostic_policy: diagnose target dialect in value input
features.summary: vc4kernel, ssavc4, and vc4 dialect operations are rejected in value-surface inputs.
features.notes: Preserves one-way stack layering.

required_vc4kernel_contract: only program_id/num_programs are valid
features.diagnostic_policy: diagnose vc4value operation other than program_id/num_programs
features.verification: audit and verifier compare vc4value op names
features.summary: vc4value memory, tile, fragment, hardware-path, lane, warp, thread, and barrier ops are forbidden.
features.notes: Keeps vc4value tiny.

required_vc4kernel_contract: memory path chosen later by planner
features.diagnostic_policy: diagnose direct memref side-effect operation
features.summary: memref.load/store/atomic/copy/dma operations are rejected to preserve the transfer/planning boundary.
features.notes: Use vector.transfer_read/write for standard memory semantics.

required_vc4kernel_contract: sparse VDW stores remain rejected
features.diagnostic_policy: diagnose sparse-store-shaped vector op
features.verification: verifier rejects listed vector store ops
features.summary: vector.scatter and vector.compressstore are rejected because sparse stores are not an accepted VC4Kernel store path.
features.notes: Future proof needed for sparse stores.

required_vc4kernel_contract: VC4Kernel locked surface is fixed/vector-16 oriented
features.diagnostic_policy: diagnose unsupported type shape
features.summary: scalable vectors, unranked memrefs, memref rank greater than 2, and vector rank greater than 2 are rejected in Phase 3.
features.notes: Staging guardrail, not permanent hardware proof.

required_vc4kernel_contract: TMU gather support is later planning
features.diagnostic_policy: diagnose if used before staged support unless explicitly allowed
features.summary: vector.gather/TMU gather-style loads are staged for later memory expansion.
features.notes: Not a Phase3 accepted surface contract.

required_vc4kernel_contract: VC4Kernel fragment_reduce exists downstream
features.diagnostic_policy: diagnose missing finite/strict policy in later phases
features.summary: vector.reduction is a planned standard representation for later reduction lowering.
features.notes: i32/f32 policy is later work.

required_vc4kernel_contract: tile planner and VC4Kernel fragment/memory support later
features.diagnostic_policy: diagnose unsupported contract shapes until Phase19
features.summary: vector.contract is the planned standard representation for later dot/GEMM lowering.
features.notes: No dot/GEMM lowering in Phase3.

required_vc4kernel_contract: VC4Kernel approximate SFU policy is explicit
features.diagnostic_policy: diagnose exact/default math approximations later
features.summary: math/SFU lowering requires explicit exact/finite/approx policy in later phases.
features.notes: Exact/default math must not silently lower to SFU.

required_vc4kernel_contract: VC4Kernel f16 storage conversion plus f32 compute
features.diagnostic_policy: diagnose native f16 arithmetic in later policies
features.summary: subword and f16 storage conversion are staged for later table-backed lowering.
features.notes: Native f16 arithmetic remains rejected downstream.

required_vc4kernel_contract: VC4Kernel rotate/composite support downstream
features.diagnostic_policy: diagnose arbitrary shuffle/permutation direct use later
features.summary: rotate, lane-broadcast composite, and limited shuffle patterns are staged for later lowering.
features.notes: Lane broadcast is composite, not a vc4kernel op.

required_vc4kernel_contract: VPM/VDR/VDW are target planning mechanisms
features.diagnostic_policy: diagnose direct hardware ops in value input
features.summary: VPM/VDR/VDW tile planning is staged for later lowering below the value surface.
features.notes: The value surface never exposes TMU/VDR/VDW/VPM ops.

required_vc4kernel_contract: N/A
features.diagnostic_policy: diagnose missing final readiness lines
features.summary: final Phase 3 lock document records readiness for Phase 4.
features.notes: Internal handoff artifact.
